observations: Photo 0 shows a purple and black steam iron station sitting atop a dark ironing-board cover/mat on what looks like a car bonnet.
Branding 'morphy richards' and 'SPEED' is visible printed on the body of the unit (photo 0).
A coiled power cord is attached to the unit; the plug end is not visible.
A semi-transparent watermark text overlays the image (marketplace logo), not seller-added proof of condition.
No boiler/base station or separate water tank is visible, suggesting this may be a cordless/compact steam iron rather than a full steam-generator station.
No close-up of the soleplate, power switch, or cord end is provided.

claims.evidence: No spec plate, wattage label, or performance demo visible in photo 0.
No power-on photo, steam output clip, or video provided.
Guarantee terms depend on seller's future conduct; cannot be confirmed from a photo.

risks.risk: Heating element / thermostat may not actually heat or regulate properly
risks.proof: Short video clip of iron powered on and steaming, or soleplate glowing warm with steam visible

risks.risk: Power cord or plug may be damaged/frayed or wrong plug type for Nigeria (UK vs NG socket)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of plug end and full cord length

risks.risk: Water tank or steam chamber may leak
risks.proof: Photo/video of water being poured in and steam released without leakage

risks.risk: Soleplate condition (scratches, residue, burn marks) affecting fabric contact
Missing accessories (base/stand, measuring cup, descaling tool) that may normally come with a steam generator model
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories together

proof_requests: Video of the iron powered on, producing steam, soleplate heating
Close-up photo of plug end and cord condition
Photo of any accessories or base station included
response.reason: Item is identifiable by visible branding as a Morphy Richards steam iron, but all functional claims (tested ok, strong steaming) are unverified from a single static photo, so it must be priced at worst case as not confirmed working until proof is supplied.
